newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices steady, limited arrivals helps.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices steady, limited arrivals helps.

text.p: Indian cotton prices held steady in a narrow trading range on Monday, dealers said.
"Fresh mill buying as well as enquiries from state agencies remained low but limited arrivals kept market in a narrow price band," one dealer said.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 840/875 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was quiet at 1,450/1,650 rupees. Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) remained steady at 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
Overall sentiment at the close remained subdued amid low physical enquiries.
